steps.label: Build the DACPAC
steps.sub: dotnet build the .sqlproj on every pull request

code:
sqlpackage /Action:Script \
  /SourceFile:"PolicyClaimsDB.dacpac" \
  /TargetConnectionString:"$CI_CONNECTION" \
  /OutputPath:"deploy-preview.sql"

# uploaded as a PR artifact -- generates the real T-SQL,
# runs nothing against the database
caption: A reviewer reads this script before the PR is allowed to merge.
Stops an unintended data-losing change even if a reviewer misses it.

subtitle: The first real test of Lesson 11's DR setup.
